chunks: Their faces will be scorched by flames, and they will grin and scowl within it.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says the fire will 'scorch the faces' of the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'scorching of faces' (talha) signifies the external manifestation of internal spiritual corruption, where the fire consumes the outward appearance as a direct consequence of neglecting the inner light of faith. The term 'kalihun' (grinning/scowling) is interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as a state of forced, painful grimacing due to the intensity of the heat, symbolizing the humiliation of those who mocked divine truth. This verse serves as a poignant reminder of the physical reality of the Hereafter, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the unity of body and soul in divine recompense.
